Others are testing or merging collector and SFTP capture tickets (1154, 1157, the capture point and raw request work) and the work order confirmation date bug. No one reported blockers.

Alex's stock sync check (ticket 1296) found Shopify with about 2,000 extra stock against only 2 extra in the other system. Tom agrees something is wrong, and Harry said the team will hop on it as a priority after the call.
Harry is still working out the Selector order flow, with a mock selector to come, and is looking at Svelte after a React-to-Svelte swap on orient cut latency about 60 times.
